column2: The circuit of the seven climes, represented by the circles of the horizons, and the degrees of the azimuth of the risings and settings of the signs on the horizon of each clime:
that is, the amount of their distance from the rising and setting points of the equinox, in the north and in the south

This circle contains the lords of the terms of the twelve signs, the lords of their triplicities by day and by night, the lords of the faces, the lords of the houses and the lords of the exaltations, God willing.

The first circle is for the terms, the one next to it for the triplicities, the one next to these two for the faces, the one next to it after the three for the houses, and the one next to all of them, which is inside it, for the exaltations. It is not from the original copy.
column3: In the codex the houses and the exaltations change places in this sentence; Nallino keeps the codex's errors in the drawing of the circles (Nallino)
